approved: Financial Services Compensation Scheme of Last Resort Levy Bill 2023

Bills on financial accountability, financial services compensation, health, national security, education and vocational training were referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration. The speaker also remarked that they hoped their next speech would be more interesting.

The government’s mismanagement of the Financial Accountability Regime bills, including a deal with the Greens that was later reversed, delayed their passage, and it broke promises on tax and superannuation, such as doubling super taxes and taxing unrealised capital gains, while the Levy review on financial advice remains unanswered.
